github.reason: Keep the private repository small and avoid consuming Actions/artifact/storage quota with binary media.

google_drive.role: optional curated media library and archive; not a public Threads media host

production_media.default: deterministic editorial card rendered by GitHub Actions
production_media.web_images: Only use a real external image when it materially improves the post and usage rights/source are clear. Never hotlink arbitrary search-result images.
